lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Cuz, he is your attorney. Not your moms. He can't disclose stuff ta mom that he talks about with you unless you tell him directly that he can. OK? So make sure that you do that.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Kinda of like you told him you wanted ta talk with us. That's the only way that we could do that. We're all set.

lines.speaker: UNRECOGNIZABLE VOICE
lines.text: Cuff him out there stand up.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Now we have ta put the cuffs back on you, Brendan.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Do you want me safe, or ta double lock 'em?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You wanna shut the tape machine off?
